scope.summary: Implement a global-edit mode that edits all similar objects together (scoped by matching shape/size/appearance across artboards) and a select-same query set gathering objects by fill/stroke color, stroke weight, opacity, blend mode, graphic style, shape kind, or symbol/component instance; global edits propagate through the standard command/validation lifecycle so model-authored global edits are auditable.
acceptance_criteria: global edit across artboards + select-same by 7 attributes + auditable lifecycle; author_ids + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: global-edit mode + select-same query reachable via author_id
test: editing one object updates all matching across artboards; select-same by each attribute; routes through validation (auditable)

target_entries: Studio / Vector / Global Edit & Select Same

risk_if_missed: No global edit; batch-similar editing missing.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
